A2-01.ko: 작은 불꽃 튕김 · 촛불 빛이 상처를 씻어 냄
A2-01.atk: a little candle flame leans forward: a soft whoosh of fire, a tiny spark flicked off the wick with a pop, a warm crackle on impact
A2-01.def: the wax body wobbles with a soft thump, the flame gutters then rises, and a small clear chime and a rinsing shimmer of light wash over it

A2-03.ko: 종다리 떼가 쪼아 댐 · 흩어졌다 다시 모임
A2-03.atk: a burst of bright trills, a flurry of small wings, then a quick patter of tiny beak pecks against the target
A2-03.def: the flock scatters: a startled flutter of many wings, a few sharp chirps, feathers whirring as they regroup

A2-04.ko: 깃털 파닥 · 쓰러져도 따뜻한 빛이 받침
A2-04.atk: a small hop and a flurry of tiny feather flaps, a soft pat of a little fist on the foe, a faint high sparkle trailing off
A2-04.def: the child tumbles with a soft cloth plop, then a warm airy glow gently cushions it: a low breathy hum and a few feathers drifting

A2-05.ko: 날개 펴고 발톱 내리꽂음 · 깃발처럼 날개 펼쳐 막음
A2-05.atk: a sharp eagle cry, a single powerful wing beat, then talons strike with a crisp scrape and a banner-like snap of feathers
A2-05.def: wings spread wide in a crest pose: a cloth-like feather snap, a talon scraping stone, a short defiant screech

A2-06.ko: 빛 고리가 돌며 부딪힘 · 맑게 울리며 흔들림
A2-06.atk: a floating ring of light glides in with a soft hum, spins faster into a bright whirr, then taps the target with a clear glassy chime
A2-06.def: the hit passes through the empty middle and clips the ring: a wavering ringing tone, a shimmer of gold sparks, the hum steadying again

A2-07.ko: 날개 치며 창 내리찌름 · 둥근 방패로 받음
A2-07.atk: white wings beat once with a heavy feathered whump, a spear drops from above with a long whistle, then lands with a bright metallic punch
A2-07.def: a round shield meets the strike: a solid wood-and-gold clang, wings flaring with a rustle, scale armour jingling

A2-09.ko: 방패 앞세워 돌진 · 작은 방패에 챙 하고 튕김
A2-09.atk: a short stabbing sword jabs from behind a raised guard: a rapid scrape, a punchy thrust, and a clipped chain-mail jingle
A2-09.def: a small round shield catches the blow with a sharp clank and a quick ring, the arm wobbling with a creak of leather straps

A2-11.ko: 작은 뿔로 들이받음 · 가볍게 뛰어 비킴
A2-11.atk: light hooves skip on grass, a short high neigh, then a small horn jabs in with a bright crystalline tink
A2-11.def: the foal shies away: a quick hoof scuffle, a startled whinny, the blow glancing off a white flank with a soft thud

A2-13.ko: 색유리 검으로 가름 · 유리 몸에 빛이 스며 더러움을 씻음
A2-13.atk: lead joints creak as a glass knight raises its sword, a bright glassy whine, then a clean cut that rings like a struck windowpane
A2-13.def: coloured panes take the blow with a sharp glass clink and a creak of lead, then light streams through them in a soft rinsing shimmer

A2-15.ko: 맹세의 철퇴 내려침 · 굳게 선 갑옷이 낮게 울림
A2-15.atk: a heavy flanged mace lifted and brought down in a solemn overhead smite: a slow metal creak, a deep dull crunch, a low bell tone swelling afterwards
A2-15.def: planted firmly with plated greaves, the body absorbs the blow with a deep armour thud and a low sustained bell ring that fades slowly

A2-16.ko: 사자 앞발 후려침 · 갈기 세우고 두껍게 버팀
A2-16.atk: heavy padded steps, a low rumbling growl, then a huge paw swipe lands with a heavy thud and a scrape of claws
A2-16.def: a thick-maned body takes the hit: a dense furry thump, a grunt, paws digging in with a gritty scrape

A2-17.ko: 물음 뒤 앞발 내리침 · 석상처럼 엎드려 받음
A2-17.atk: a low humming voice poses a question, a pause, then a heavy lion paw drops with a stone-dense thud and a rustle of folding wings
A2-17.def: the sphinx settles low like a carved statue: a deep solid thump, a slow wing rustle, a calm resonant hum

A2-20.ko: 날개 펼쳐 덮쳐 베기 · 큰 날개가 깃털 펄럭이며 감쌈
A2-20.atk: enormous wings snap open with a big feathery boom, a gust, then a longsword sweeps down with a deep steel whoosh and a weighty clang
A2-20.def: a vast pair of wings folds across the front: a dense wall of feather flutter, a muffled whump, and a soft hanging shimmer of settling down

A2-21.ko: 날개로 후려치고 쉭 · 날개 아래 품어 막음
A2-21.atk: a long neck snaps forward with a sharp hiss, broad wings beat with a heavy whoosh, then a wing-bone strike lands with a firm smack
A2-21.def: great white wings arch over the body: a soft thick feather rush, a muffled thump, a low warning honk

A2-22.ko: 종소리 울려 밀어냄 · 청동 몸이 웅웅 받음
A2-22.atk: a great bronze bell swings back with a creak, then tolls once: a deep resonant boom, a ringing wave of sound rolling out and striking with a warm shimmer
A2-22.def: the blow lands on thick bronze: a heavy clang that blooms into a long humming overtone, slowly fading

A2-24.ko: 모은 빛을 되쏨 · 거울이 맑게 울려 튕김
A2-24.atk: a tall mirror tilts with a gilt-frame creak, gathers light into a rising glassy shimmer, then flashes it out in a bright ringing beam
A2-24.def: the strike hits silvered glass: a high clear ring, a bright flash bouncing the blow back, a faint tinkle along the frame

A2-25.ko: 성화 불길 뿜어냄 · 다시 타올라 더러움을 태움
A2-25.atk: a brass brazier flares: a deep roaring whoosh of white-gold fire, a crackle of embers, then a hot blast that hisses on impact
A2-25.def: the flame bends from the blow with a fluttering roar, rises again, and a clean purifying hiss and soft chime sweep over the wound

A2-27.ko: 뿔 세우고 돌진 · 서서 뿔로 받아 맑게 울림
A2-27.atk: hooves thunder in a full gallop, a ringing neigh, then a long horn drives in with a bright piercing chime
A2-27.def: the unicorn plants its hooves and catches the strike on its horn: a clear crystal ring, a snort, hooves scraping

A2-28.ko: 대리석 주먹 내리침 · 돌처럼 울리고 비둘기 푸드덕
A2-28.atk: stone grinds as a statue steps off its plinth, a slow heavy swing, then a marble fist lands with a deep solid crunch
A2-28.def: white marble takes the hit: a dense stone knock, a few chips skittering, a startled flutter of pigeons from its shoulders

A2-29.ko: 날개 치며 창 휘두름 · 낡은 방패가 세월 소리로 받음
A2-29.atk: broad wings beat in a strong rhythm, a long spear sweeps in a heavy arc with a deep whoosh, then lands with a solid ringing crack
A2-29.def: a battered round shield takes the blow with a seasoned clang, old armour creaking, wings settling with a calm rustle

A2-30.ko: 불꽃 날개 휘몰이 · 날개 불꽃이 막아 낮게 웅웅
A2-30.atk: six burning wings sweep forward: a rush of flapping air, crackling golden flame, then a blazing swelling roar that bursts into sparkling embers
A2-30.def: blazing wings snap shut across the body: a thick whoosh of feathers, a fiery crackle absorbing the blow, and a low warm halo hum

A2-31.ko: 네 얼굴이 함께 포효 · 네 날개 겹쳐 막음
A2-31.atk: four voices roar at once, lion, eagle, ox and a solemn chant, four wings beat, then a heavy bronze-bright impact rings out
A2-31.def: four wings fold in layers around the body: thick overlapping feather rushes, a deep bronze clang, a low four-toned hum

A2-33.ko: 거대한 유리창이 밀어냄 · 색유리가 종탑처럼 울림
A2-33.atk: a huge stained-glass window shifts forward with a groan of lead, a broad glassy sweep, then a ringing slam of coloured panes
A2-33.def: great panes catch the blow: a loud bell-like glass ring, lead frames creaking, and a soft protective glow humming as nothing breaks

A2-34.atk: a high crystalline note swells, rays of white starlight gather with a shimmering hum, then a bright burst of light strikes with a ringing chime cluster
A2-34.def: the blow slides off a radiant star body: a soft glassy whoosh, prism sparkles tinkling, a calm high hum

A2-36.ko: 여섯 날개 내리쳐 빛 폭발 · 빛 날개가 몸을 감싸 울림
A2-36.atk: wings of dawn spread with a huge feathered boom, a mounting radiant swell, then a blazing sunrise lance of light slams down with a brilliant chime cluster
A2-36.def: six great wings shut around the body in layered feather rushes; a high bright ring of sunlit glass and a deep warm hum swallow the strike

A2-41.ko: 날개 접고 달려 들이받음 · 부딪혀 나뒹굼
A2-41.atk: wings fold with a feather snap, hooves pound in a reckless charge, then a full-body ram crashes through with a heavy splintering crunch
A2-41.def: no armour, it takes the hit at a run: a heavy body thud, a startled whinny, hooves skidding and wings flaring for balance

A2-42.ko: 하늘에서 흑요 칼로 한 번 내려침 · 피가 멎지 않음 · 얇은 몸이 번쩍하고 쓰러짐
A2-42.atk: a long obsidian executioner's blade is raised high and plunges with a falling whistle, one heavy cleaving chop, then a bright flash of light and a slow dripping bleed
A2-42.def: a lightly built body folds under the blow with a thin metallic clatter, wing feathers scattering and a short fading ring

A2-43.ko: 불꽃 날개로 내리꽂는 칼 · 맑은 성광 울림 (v3.90 공격 소리 바꿈)
A2-43.atk: a flame flares on burning wings, a fast swoosh dive, a sharp sword strike on the target, a clear chime and radiant shimmer
A2-43.def: frail wings crackle and curl under the blow, embers tinkling like falling glass, a short sizzle and a fading orange hiss

SP-A2.ko: 황금 성검 천둥 가름 · 날개와 보호막이 겹쳐 울림
SP-A2.atk: a golden sword and rising wings: a heavy feather boom, a long shining blade sweep, a thunderous clang with layered bell-like overtones blossoming outward
SP-A2.def: a ringing coin-like shield of light blossoms in front, a deep sunburst bell tone, wings fanning, and a clear glassy sparkle as the blow dissolves

UN-A2.ko: 날개 펼쳐 대신 맞음 · 날개 그늘이 휙 드리워 막음
UN-A2.atk: a feathered shield-wing is swung like a battering ram: a huge air-parting whoosh, a heavy feather-and-steel slap, a bright crack, a soft downy flutter after
UN-A2.def: a giant wing sweeps across to take the hit for an ally: a rush of feathers, a deep shadowy thump, a dim shaded hum falling over the impact like a curtain

UN-A2-7.ko: 새벽 종 내리쳐 빛 번쩍 · 사제복에 빛이 살아남
UN-A2-7.atk: a staff topped with a sun bell is struck down: a ringing swing, a pure crystalline gong, then a shimmering surge of morning light breaking like a wave
UN-A2-7.def: robes absorb the hit with a soft thud, then a rising warm glow and a gentle upward chime, like a fallen thing standing again

EP-A2-1.ko: 돌 발굽 내리찍음 · 돌 몸에 빛 보호막 코인
EP-A2-1.atk: carved stone wings grind open, a deep bull's lowing, then a stone hoof stamps down with a heavy rock crunch
EP-A2-1.def: a limestone body takes the blow with a dense stone thud, and a coin-sized ward spins up around it with a quick chiming glimmer

EP-A2-2.ko: 장벽 위에서 장창 찔러 박음 · 어둑한 방패에 정화의 빛
EP-A2-2.atk: a heavy pike jabs out from behind a wall: a long dry hiss, a deep iron-headed thrust with a hard crunch, a violet-gold glow flickering at the tip
EP-A2-2.def: a thick shield with a dim glowing rim blocks with a dense iron boom, then a sunset-coloured hum swells into a clear chime that rinses the air clean

EP-A2-3.ko: 여섯 날개 후려침 · 날개 아래 커다란 후광 천막
EP-A2-3.atk: a great wing sweeps in, then a lance of dusk-gold light thunders down: a huge feathered gust, deep swelling bell hum, a heavy brilliant impact
EP-A2-3.def: a vast feathered canopy unfurls overhead and a large halo of light flares like a shimmering dome, sunlight chiming against the blow with a glassy ring

PN-A2-C1.ko: 작은 돌 몸이 툭 부딪힘 · 꼼짝 않고 버팀
PN-A2-C1.atk: a small statue tips forward with a stone scrape, a short shove, and a modest rock tock
PN-A2-C1.def: a little stone figure does not budge: a solid dull knock, a fine dust trickle, a faint creak of its plinth

PN-A2-C2.ko: 눈 박힌 바퀴가 굴러 밀침 · 바퀴가 돌며 육중하게 버팀
PN-A2-C2.atk: interlocking golden wheels spin up with a deep metallic hum, a rumbling roll, then a grinding rim strike with a bright ring
PN-A2-C2.def: the wheels lock in place: a heavy metallic thud, a low steady spinning hum, many eyes blinking with soft clicks

PN-A2-C3.ko: 날개 치며 앞발 내리침 · 날개 펴고 버팀
PN-A2-C3.atk: big wings beat over a stone wall, a dive with a rushing whoosh, then front hooves strike down with a solid crack
PN-A2-C3.def: wings spread wide against the hit: a thick feather rush, a firm hoof stamp on stone, a steady snort

PN-A2-U1.ko: 빈 갑옷이 맹세 검 휘두름 · 새긴 맹세가 빛나 더러움을 씻음
PN-A2-U1.atk: hollow plate moves with an empty ringing echo, an engraved sword whistles out, then a clean slash lands with a bright etched-metal clang
PN-A2-U1.def: the empty armour rings like a bell, the engraved words hum with light, and a soft clean chime washes outward like light through water

PN-A2-U2.ko: 종다리 합창이 밀어냄 · 노래가 겹쳐 버팀
PN-A2-U2.atk: a chorus of larks swells: bright overlapping trills, a flurry of wings, then a warm pulse of song striking with a soft radiant chime
PN-A2-U2.def: the larks sing on through the hit: layered trills holding steady, a gentle protective shimmer, a few feathers drifting down

PN-A2-R.ko: 새벽빛 갈기 세우고 밀침 · 칼날이 빛에 미끄러져 튕김
PN-A2-R.atk: a sunray mane flares with a warm hum, a deep roar, then a heavy shoulder shove lands with a solid furry thud
PN-A2-R.def: the blade slides off a mane of dawn light: a bright glancing ring, a soft shimmer, a low steady growl

PN-A2-E.ko: 봉인의 대검 땅 울림 · 보호막이 겹겹 맞물림
PN-A2-E.atk: an ancient greatsword drags and swings with a long ringing scrape, a heavy sealed-gate boom and a deep resonant gong bursting with pale light
PN-A2-E.def: layered ward upon ward: a coin-like halo shield rings once, a deep door-like thud follows, pale bars of light locking into place with grinding chimes

UP-A2-11.ko: 뿔을 창처럼 낮추고 돌진 · 흰 옆구리로 비껴 받음
UP-A2-11.atk: galloping hooves pound on grass, a ringing high neigh, then a long spiral horn drives in with a bright piercing crystalline crack and light tearing like silk
UP-A2-11.def: the unicorn wheels aside: hooves scuffle, a sharp snort, the blow glances off a white flank and the horn parries with a clear ringing clack

UP-A2-15.ko: 서약 철퇴 벼락 내림 · 서약 갑주가 낮은 종소리
UP-A2-15.atk: a covenant mace swung down with a heavier deeper smite than before: a stone-like crunch, a bell tone, then a golden pulse of light rippling out
UP-A2-15.def: a full covenant plate suit rings with a rich deep bell tone, a long steady thud, then three faint echoing hums of oaths held

UP-A2-17.ko: 낮은 물음 뒤 거대한 앞발이 내리침 · 황금 석상처럼 엎드려 받음
UP-A2-17.atk: a deep humming voice poses a question, a held pause, then a huge golden lion paw drops with a massive stone-dense thud and great wings folding with a heavy rustle
UP-A2-17.def: the golden sphinx settles low like a carved monument: a deep solid thump, a slow broad wing rustle, a calm resonant hum that rings in metal

UP-A2-22.ko: 거대한 성종이 울려 밀어냄 · 두꺼운 청동이 웅웅 받음
UP-A2-22.atk: a huge bronze bell swings back with a deep creak, then tolls once with a colossal boom, a wave of sound rolling outward and striking with a bright golden shimmer
UP-A2-22.def: the blow lands on thick bronze: a massive clang blooming into a long deep humming overtone that rolls across stone and slowly fades

UP-A2-24.ko: 큰 거울이 빛을 모아 쏨 · 은빛 유리에 맞아 되튕김
UP-A2-24.atk: a towering gilt mirror tilts with a heavy frame creak, gathers light into a swelling glassy whine, then flashes it out in a blazing ringing beam
UP-A2-24.def: the strike hits a broad silvered pane: a high clear ring, a bright flash throwing the blow back, a cascade of fine tinkles along the gilt frame

MA-02.ko: 맨 앞 기사 위 빛 보호막 내림
MA-02.cast: a warm descending swell of light settles over the front knight, a soft glassy bubble forming with a bright chime as armour plates unclasp with a metallic loosening

SA2-01.ko: 성벽에서 나팔 한 번 · 앞줄 달려나감
SA2-01.cast: a single long brass war horn blast echoes off a wall, then rows of boots begin pounding and a rising sword-rattle swell surges forward

SA2-02.ko: 낮게 버티는 기도 · 막을 때마다 작은 빛 방울이 똑똑 쌓임
SA2-02.cast: a low steady murmured prayer, two soft shield shimmers settling in, then a few tiny glassy droplet chimes stacking one on another like light collecting in a bowl

SA2-03.ko: 여럿의 낮은 기도 소리 · 전장의 소음이 빨려 들어가듯 고요해짐
SA2-03.cast: a low murmured choir of many voices in unison, a soft bell tap, then the surrounding battle noise is sucked away into a hushed hollow silence with a faint high ring

MA-08.cast: molten gold light pours over every ally and cools into iron: a low pouring hiss, a metallic hardening clink, a final deep anvil-like ring

SA2-04.cast: a falling sword blow with a hard bright crack, followed by a recoil of light that swirls around the knight with a gentle shield chime

MA-10.ko: 쓰러지며 깃털처럼 흩어지는 빛 · 양옆에 방울 막이 맺힘
MA-10.cast: a quiet falling exhale and a soft armour slump, a breathy rush of scattering feathers of light, then two gentle glassy bubble chimes forming left and right

SA2-07.ko: 커다란 저울이 쿵 내려앉아 기울어짐 · 사슬 짤랑
SA2-07.cast: a heavy brass balance sets down with a deep metallic thunk, its pans swing with a creaking chain jingle, then settle with one solemn low gong

MA-14.ko: 모인 빛이 한꺼번에 터지는 동틈 · 끝에 따스한 잔빛
MA-14.cast: a deep swelling rumble rising like a sunrise, a bright bursting choir-chord whoosh of light sweeping outward with a sharp sizzle on impact, then fading into a warm soft healing shimmer

RA2-1.cast: the sky brightens with a rumbling rising whine, a pause, then a world-filling booming flash of light shaking everything, leaving a bell-like silence over one sheltered figure

NA2-1.ko: 따스한 빛이 내려앉음 · 무기가 땅에 떨어져 쨍그랑 · 고요한 숨
NA2-1.cast: a warm descending shimmer of light like a slow harp gliss, a weapon dropping to stone with a dull clatter, then a calm soft exhale and a gentle bell tone

NA2-2.cast: six huge wings beat overhead in a deep feathery thunder, drifting light feathers fall with tiny tinkles, each ally gains a soft shimmering ward

US-A2-1.ko: 모든 아군 손에 빛의 검이 쥐어짐
US-A2-1.cast: a deep blade-forging ring, light pouring into every weapon with a rising sparkle, then a brilliant unison of blades unsheathing with a crisp metallic swell

US-A2-2.ko: 한낮 햇살이 가장 높은 칼을 태움
US-A2-2.cast: a blazing high-noon swell, concentrated beams scorching with a searing crackle and the hiss of melting steel, then a quiet protective chime

PS-A2-1.ko: 앞의 칼을 뒤 아군이 대신 받음
PS-A2-1.cast: a blade strikes with a sharp clang that is swallowed and carried away, a soft golden thread hums between two bodies, then a muffled thud lands behind as a gentle halo shimmer rings once

PS-A2-2.cast: a calm descending wash of light, blades clattering one by one as they settle flat, then an even smooth glassy hum evening everything out

RS-A2-1.cast: shields slam down and breastplates unbuckle with ringing silver clanks, a bright swelling tone gathers overhead, then a great blade of light strikes with a clear bell crash and pierces on into a second impact

RS-A2-2.ko: 날개에 칼날이 막혀 쨍 · 빛이 모였다가 한 번에 되돌아 꽂힘
RS-A2-2.cast: a ringing blade-on-ward clang absorbed into a rising gathered hum of light, a held breath, then a bright reversed whoosh striking back with a radiant crack

RS-A2-3.cast: a circle of light is drawn with a clean glowing hiss, a protective dome humming up around the ally, while a rival's blade dulls with a dim downward whine

CS-A2.ko: 숨은 마법이 사라지고 창끝에 빛이 맺힘
CS-A2.cast: a clean wave of light sweeps across, a hidden trap fizzles out with a short sealed pop and a puff of hush, then a lance tip flashes with a bright ring

IA2-1.ko: 검은 칼을 꺼내 듦 · 기도 문구와 함께 천으로 감쌈
IA2-1.equip: a jagged obsidian blade is drawn with a dry glassy scrape, a cloth wrap is cinched tight around the hilt, and a short whispered blessing hums over a faint dark ring

IA2-2.equip: a polished silver shield's straps are pulled tight with a leather creak, a buckle snaps, and a tap with a knuckle rings clear and bright

S2-1.equip: a sigil pendant on a thin chain is hung round the neck: a delicate chain jingle, a soft glowing hum, a faint chime

I3-2.equip: a tall tower shield is lifted and planted with a deep thud on stone, a gate-like iron hinge creak, and a long low ring when knocked

IA2-5.equip: a holy sword is raised from its sheath with a long pure scrape, a warm swelling of light settling on the blade, one gentle bell tone

S4-1.equip: a small reliquary box clicks open on stiff gold hinges, a hush of light spills, glassy sparkles hover, a single low chime

SR-A2.equip: a tall longbow is strung with a tight wooden bend, a bowstring is pulled with a creak and released in a test twang, a faint shimmering whistle trails away

IR-A2.ko: 맹세 방패를 팔에 끼우자 빛이 번짐
IR-A2.equip: a heavy oath shield clamped onto the forearm with a buckle snap, a soft golden glow spreading, and a coin-like ring when it is rapped

PI-A2.equip: a large feather is slid into an armour clasp with a silky whisper, the plate stiffens with a soft metallic hum, and the feather's edge rings with a thin sharp blade-like shing

TK-A2-1.ko: 빛 검 반짝 휘두름 · 빛 몸이 꿈쩍 않고 맞음
TK-A2-1.atk: a sword of woven light hums into being and slashes: a fresh electric-glass whine, a clean cutting swish, a tinkling shimmer where it ends
TK-A2-1.def: a body of light stands firm: the strike lands on a faint glowing shield with a soft crystalline thump, light rippling like water and settling back
